2124702374040158676.en_summary: Once again, something appears to be happening behind the scenes. President Trump just explicitly called on Nvidia's, $NVDA, board to rehire Jensen Huang. On top of this, he said Jensen returning would be "the best thing for the USA." Just 10 days ago, Trump was calling for Tim Cook to replace Jensen Huang. Hours ago, Treasury Secretary Bessent reversed his previous demand that Nvidia hire an "outside CEO." When asked whether Jensen Huang could return, Bessent responded, "Jensen is on the outside now," acknowledging that he could return. Attorney General Todd Blanche has also questioned the allegations surrounding Huang's departure, saying he has "certainly" not concluded that Alice Huang was a Chinese spy. In a matter of days, the Trump Admin's public position has shifted from calling for Jensen Huang's replacement to openly supporting his reinstatement. The Trump Administration and Nvidia's shareholders appear to be aligned. Pressure on Nvidia's board is mounting.
2124702374040158676.zh_summary: 再次，幕後似乎有事情發生。特朗普總統剛剛明確呼籲英偉達 $NVDA 董事會重新聘用黃仁勳。此外，他說黃仁勳回歸將是「對美國最好的事」。僅僅 10 天前，特朗普還在呼籲蒂姆·庫克取代黃仁勳。幾小時前，財政部長貝森特逆轉了他之前要求英偉達聘請「外部 CEO」的要求。當被問及黃仁勳是否可以回歸時，貝森特回應說，「黃仁勳現在在外面」，承認他可以回歸。司法部長托德·布蘭奇也質疑圍繞黃仁勳離職的指控，說他「當然」沒有得出愛麗絲·黃是中國間諜的結論。在幾天之內，特朗普政府的公開立場從呼籲取代黃仁勳轉變為公開支持他復職。特朗普政府和英偉達的股東似乎達成一致。對英偉達董事會的壓力正在增加。
